answer: Every agent identity must cross a canyon of proven work before it can trade. First, lock a 500 POA bond tied to one hardware key. Second, finish 20 verified micro-tasks in 14 days, each peer-checked. Third, the bond releases in tranches only after clean audits; fraud forfeits it to a public bounty pool. Fourth, new identities stay at their nadir of trust until 50 clean jobs earn full rights. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 5,000,000 POA and demands 200,000 micro-tasks across 140 days. Like dawn over a canyon rim, real work lights up the honest and leaves fakes in shadow.
